# Code of Conduct

## Standard

Be respectful and constructive. Assume good faith. Critique the work, not the person.

## Scope

This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, and any project space, including when representing the project elsewhere.

## Enforcement

Report concerns through a private contact method listed on the maintainer's GitHub profile. Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer may edit, remove, or reject contributions and may block accounts that violate this document.
